intro: Cazul is an ancient, blind orc warlock dwelling in the darkened cavern of the Cleft of Shadow beneath Orgrimmar. Despite having lost his physical sight, he possesses profound occult insight and guides rising practitioners of the dark arts seeking to expand their demonic command.

p: Tucked away in the cavernous depths of the Cleft of Shadow, Cazul endures as a relic of old warlock traditions. Though entirely blind, his senses are attuned to the shifting currents of the Twisting Nether and the whispers of demonic entities. Rising warlocks are often directed to him when seeking to expand their mastery and bind more dangerous servitors. His sharp awareness and occult wisdom make it clear that losing his eyes cost him nothing of his arcane power.
